note: ornate fonts. small: 8x8, ink slot = row+1 (1-7), shadow slot 8. large: 8x16 as top and bottom tiles, ink slot = (row mod 8)+1 (1-8), shadow slot 9; top and bottom tiles take their own palettes. chars: ASCII U+0020-U+007E then U+25B2 U+25BC U+25C0 U+25B6. Palettes: the SUNSET examples (RGB555, slot 0 transparent).
